purpose: Reusable cross-system data structure for the 16 evidence-bound systems — genuinely comparable dials, not page-by-page category mimicry.

wealth.denominator_note: Household / SCF–DFA wealth shares; not firm-level concentration

labor.denominator_note: Real wage / productivity indices — not unemployment alone

competition.denominator_note: Enforcement / entry dials — not a market-power proof (CC-CLAIM-003 NEE)

democracy.denominator_note: Political-money concentration dial D04 is the cross-system comparable; journalism geos are AR-pilot only

healthcare.denominator_note: HPSA / primary-care access counts — not outcome quality scores

agriculture.denominator_note: Rural/local capital and farm structure; AR processing panel is Arkansas-geography supplementary

fiscal.denominator_note: Federal receipts/outlays/debt as % GDP — not Arkansas state budget identity
